scope: nRF Connect SDK Bare Metal v2.0.1 ble_hids_mouse on nRF54LM20 with S115 10.0.1

bluez_oracle_gate.failure: advertising target not discovered before the 60 second hard timeout
advertising target not discovered before the 60 second hard timeout

gate_tool_followup.change: record and verify StopDiscovery on discovery-timeout paths

resolved_behavioral_divergence.stage: first application log call, before button initialization and before nrf_sdh_enable_request
resolved_behavioral_divergence.observation: the consumer emitted only the first byte of the first official log message and made no further visible progress
resolved_behavioral_divergence.root_cause: the shim issued one DMA START per byte and entered WFE without enabling a UARTE interrupt; it did not follow the LM20 RAM-buffered UARTE transaction and STOP/TXSTOPPED state machine
resolved_behavioral_divergence.correction: copy one literal log line plus CRLF to an aligned RAM buffer, issue one EasyDMA transaction, use END-to-STOP, and bound polling for TXSTOPPED or BUSERROR

current_behavioral_divergence.stage: after sd_irq_init and within the newly restored official irq_init path, before main
current_behavioral_divergence.observation: the serial transcript is empty, the initialization token is absent, and the BlueZ gate observes no advertisement
current_behavioral_divergence.control_flow_evidence: the prior image executed board, GPIOTE, timer and sd_irq constructors and reached main; the only newly restored executable init entry is official irq_init, which logs, calls CallSoftDeviceResetHandler and sets the forwarding magic
current_behavioral_divergence.static_vector_audit: all IRQs registered by official irq_init resolve to the same static MDK vector slots and official forwarding handlers; SD_EVT resolves to SWI01
current_behavioral_divergence.boundary: the first observable divergence is before the first irq_init log becomes visible or before CallSoftDeviceResetHandler returns; distinguishing those cases requires another instrumented or GDB run
current_behavioral_divergence.indispensable_dependency_boundary: the official SoftDevice reset/IRQ forwarding path depends on pre-main platform and SoC lifecycle state supplied by the official Zephyr build; reproducing more of that state is no longer a thin source-equivalent adapter

stopping_decision.s115_portability_conclusion: the locked S115 application and ABI remain valid in the official oracle, but the pure CMake experiment cannot reproduce the official pre-main reset/IRQ lifecycle with the bounded thin adapter
stopping_decision.resume_condition: do not resume S115 adaptation without a new plan that explicitly permits a wider official runtime dependency or a newly documented platform contract
stopping_decision.next_route: stop the S115 adaptation experiment and continue the PLAN-defined LM20-only lower-layer route
